name: LinkList
intent: A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.
usage: Use LinkList for a short set of places to go from a page, like Quick links in a record's rail or related pages under a heading. It is one component: pass items, each with an id and a label, and href or onClick. icon puts a brand icon before the label; description adds a short line under it; external opens the link in a new tab and swaps the chevron for the new-tab mark. Put it in a Section, which gives it its title and box; the list draws no card of its own and its labels line up with the Section title. label names the list for screen readers, like Quick links. For a single link in text use Link; for actions use Buttons or a DropdownMenu. See contracts/linklist.json for the full contract.

itemShape.label: string
itemShape.href: string? Where the row goes. Without it the row is a button that runs onClick.
itemShape.icon: string? Material Symbols name before the label, in the brand icon colour.
itemShape.description: string? A short line under the label.
itemShape.external: boolean? Opens in a new tab; the chevron becomes the new-tab mark.

items.note: The links in order. Keep it short: two to eight.

label.note: Names the list for screen readers, like Quick links.

useWhen: Quick links in a record's side rail.
A few related pages to jump to from a settings or detail page.
doNot: Do not use it for actions that change data. Use Buttons or a DropdownMenu.
Do not use it for page navigation across the app. Use SideNav or Tabs.
Do not put it in a Card or draw a box round it yourself. Put it in a Section.
Do not build a list of Links or a one-column Table for quick links. Use LinkList.
a11y: A list named by label, so the number of links is read.
Each row is one link, or a button when it has no href, reachable with Tab, with a visible focus ring.
The chevron and icon are hidden from screen readers; external rows say opens in a new tab.
snippet:
<Section title="Quick links">
  <LinkList label="Quick links" items={[{ id: "tax", label: "Tax Related List", href: "/tax" }, { id: "portal", label: "Customer Portal", href: "/portal" }]} />
</Section>
